svg.title: Advanced Phaser layout variants built from daw_elements.svg components
svg.desc: Exact external component references: kick_tool_rail, group_kick_generator-3-2-9-5 Stereo Mix Output, knob_strip_default, knob_strip_default-0-1 selectable-unit knob, widget_value_drag_box, widget_normal_sliders, g23/g22 tab buttons, and g24 segmented button group.
svg.text: Exact daw_elements.svg controls · 320 px total height · no input panel

g.text: Focus: precise rhythmic and stereo motion; response remains a secondary tab.
XY records as two automatable parameters
Focus: playable macro control; mode morph and XY are modulation/automation targets.
Focus: the audible all-pass/notch structure itself; handles replace several knobs.
Focus: teaches the architecture; bipolar feedback and drive are visually explicit.
